project_name: SDF — Sandeep Dangi Fitness (India Online Training)
archetype: THE PERFORMANCE PRO (Elite Athleticism, Tactical Precision & High Energy)
theme: Dark Mode Default (Deep Tinted Obsidian #090C10 & Carbon Steel #121720 with Crimson Flame #FF3838 & Volt Amber #FF9F1C accents)

typography.heading_font: Barlow Condensed, sans-serif (or Bebas Neue / Outfit)
typography.font_pairings: Barlow Condensed Heavy/Bold for Headlines + Plus Jakarta Sans for Body + JetBrains Mono for stats, badges & metrics
typography.h1_hero: text-4xl sm:text-6xl lg:text-7xl font-extrabold tracking-tight uppercase leading-none
typography.h2_section: text-3xl sm:text-4xl lg:text-5xl font-bold tracking-tight uppercase

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Tactical Asymmetry & High-Impact Grid. Generous 2-3x vertical padding (py-20 to py-32). 1px crisp borders with inner glow.

motion_and_animations.kinetic_hero: Line-by-line staggered reveal using framer-motion (y: 40 -> 0, opacity: 0 -> 1)
motion_and_animations.gym_equipment_effects: Rotating 3D/2D barbell plate motifs in background, subtle dumbbell pulse on hover, pulsing workout energy ring around coach badges
motion_and_animations.marquee: Slow drifting editorial ticker for achievements, certifications, and languages (English, Hindi, Punjabi)
motion_and_animations.counters: Animated key statistics counting up (26+ Years Experience, 5000+ Transformations, NASM Certified)
motion_and_animations.scroll_reveals: Scroll-triggered section reveals with reduced-motion fallback

component_structure.navigation: Navbar with Logo, desktop links (HOME, TRANSFORMATIONS, ONLINE COACHING, CONTEST PREP, ABOUT SANDEEP), language badges (EN | HI | PB), and APPLY NOW CTA
component_structure.hero_section: Kinetic headline reveal + high-impact transformation imagery + Apply Now & WhatsApp CTAs + Trust strip (26 yrs exp, 5000+ transformed, NASM certified, Canadian titles)
component_structure.proof_marquee: Horizontal continuous marquee of key mantras & achievement highlights
component_structure.credibility_counters: Interactive 4-stat grid with animated count-up numbers & gold accent badges
component_structure.transformations_gallery: Filterable case studies (Over 35s, Muscle Gain, Fat Loss, Contest Prep) with before/after comparison sliders, metrics (e.g. -18kg in 16 weeks), client profiles, and short audio/quote testimonials
component_structure.about_sandeep_story: Narrative section highlighting 26-year journey, single father story, father's memory promise, Canadian bodybuilding titles, and coaching philosophy (Controlled training, Proper technique, Disciplined nutrition, Honest feedback)
component_structure.coaching_features: 4-pillar breakdown: Customized Indian Nutrition, Structured Gym/Home Training, Weekly Video Accountability, WhatsApp VIP Support
component_structure.apply_modal: Multi-step interactive application form (Name, Age, Location, Fitness Goal, Current Weight, WhatsApp Number) with instant confirmation
component_structure.floating_whatsapp: Fixed bottom-right WhatsApp button with quick-chat popup prompt

instructions_to_main_agent: Build a complete multi-page navigation setup using react-router-dom or tab-based routing (Home, Transformations, Online Coaching, Contest Prep, About Sandeep).
Ensure ALL interactive elements (buttons, inputs, links, tabs, modal triggers) include a `data-testid` attribute (e.g., data-testid='apply-now-btn', data-testid='whatsapp-chat-btn').
Include explicit language indicator badges: 'Coaching Available in English, Hindi (हिंदी) & Punjabi (ਪੰਜਾਬੀ)'.
Use framer-motion for kinetic hero reveal and smooth scroll interactions.
Do NOT use pure white backgrounds or default Vercel themes; stick strictly to the dark performance pro obsidian palette.
Implement gym equipment animated motifs (rotating SVG weight plates, pulsing dumbbell icons) in the background and hero section.
Include Sonner toasts for form submit feedback and copy-to-clipboard interactions.
Add placeholder WhatsApp action with direct link handler: 'https://wa.me/919876543210?text=Hi%20Sandeep,%20I%20want%20to%20apply%20for%20online%20coaching'.
UNIVERSAL GUIDELINES FOR MAIN AGENT: You tend to converge toward generic, 'on distribution' outputs. Avoid this: make creative, distinctive frontends that surprise and delight.
Dark colors look good when used independently without gradients. DO NOT use dark colors as gradients.
Don't make generic centered layouts, simplistic gradients, and uniform styling.
Create depth through layered design elements with z-index hierarchy.
Use glass-morphism effects with backdrop filters (12-24px blur).
You MUST NOT apply universal transition (e.g., transition: all). Exclude transforms from universal transitions.
You MUST NOT center align the app container (.App { text-align: center; }).
Always use modern button styles like pill-shaped, or sharp button with interaction animations & color relevant to the app style.
NEVER use AI assistant Emoji characters (🤖, 🧠, 💭, 💡, 🔮, 🎯) for icons; use lucide-react or phosphor icons.
Every interaction needs micro-animations - hover states, transitions, parallax effects, and entrance animations.
Use 2-3x more spacing than feels comfortable. Cramped designs look cheap.
Subtle grain textures, noise overlays, custom selection states, and loading animations separate good from extraordinary.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.
